# Resolved IT

> Resolved IT is an IT support and security systems provider based in Mittagong, NSW, servicing businesses across the Southern Highlands of NSW — including Bowral, Mittagong, Moss Vale, Bundanoon, Robertson and Goulburn.

Resolved IT has provided corporate IT support and business technology services for almost 20 years, based on professional expertise and friendly, responsive customer service. The business is licensed for security system installation (Master Security License 4107752977, via AST Technologies) and works with local law firms, veterinary practices, real estate agencies, retail and leisure businesses.

## Key Facts

- Business name: Resolved IT
- Address: 1/118 Main St, Mittagong, NSW 2575, Australia
- Phone: (02) 4803 9150
- Business hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am–5:00pm. Weekends and public holidays by arrangement.
- Service area: Bowral, Mittagong, Moss Vale, Bundanoon, Robertson, Goulburn, and the wider Southern Highlands, NSW
- Services: IT support (ad-hoc and managed/proactive), servers and networking, backups and disaster recovery, virus and malware removal, cyber security, hardware procurement, cloud solutions, domain names and website hosting, and security alarm systems (design, integration and licensed installation)
